The mid-credits scene is the main link: it puts Monica in an X-Men world with Beast. How Doomsday uses it has not been explained. The rest of the film is lighter background, so one scene is the part to catch if you are short on time.

title: What If...?, Season 2
oneLiner: The animated multiverse anthology continues with new alternate-history stories told by the Watcher.

cards.title: The story
cards.body: Season 2 of the animated anthology has nine episodes, released daily from December 22 to 30, 2023. Each one is a stand-alone alternate universe watched by Uatu the Watcher, who is supposed to observe the multiverse without interfering. Episodes cover Nebula joining the Nova Corps, Peter Quill attacking Earth, Happy Hogan saving Christmas, Tony Stark crashing on Sakaar, Captain Carter facing a brainwashed Steve Rogers, Kahhori gaining the Tesseract's power, Hela allied with Wenwu, and the Avengers in 1602.

cards.title: Key moments
cards.body: The season builds toward Strange Supreme, a Doctor Strange variant who has been capturing other variants to feed a machine called the Forge, hoping to resurrect his lost universe. In the finale, Captain Carter and Kahhori stop him, and he sacrifices himself. The Watcher then restores that universe and Carter asks to see more of the multiverse.

cards.title: Post-credits
cards.body: Episode 4 has a mid-credits scene in which the Grandmaster, now a puddle, begs Topaz to collect him. Other episodes have no credits scene.

cards.title: Why it matters for Doomsday
cards.body: Weak link. The show is animated and set in separate alternate universes, and nothing in it is tied to Doomsday by any announcement. It is useful mainly as a picture of how large the multiverse is. You can skip it and miss no plot.

title: Echo
oneLiner: Maya Lopez returns home to Oklahoma and faces her family's history and the Kingpin.

cards.title: The story
cards.body: All five episodes were released together on January 9, 2024. After shooting Wilson Fisk in Hawkeye, Maya Lopez, a deaf Choctaw woman raised partly by the Kingpin, leaves New York and goes home to Tamaha, Oklahoma. She wants to leave her old life behind but ends up facing it when Fisk survives and comes after her. The story digs into her Native heritage, her family and the ancestral power running through the women in her line. It is darker and more grounded than most Marvel shows.

cards.title: Key moments
cards.body: Flashbacks and visions of Maya's Choctaw ancestors anchor the series. Matt Murdock appears briefly as Daredevil in a fight with Maya shown in flashback. Fisk offers Maya his empire back, and she refuses to kill him, but she also refuses to follow him. In the finale he kidnaps her family at the powwow, and Maya shares her powers with them. She takes Fisk into a memory of his father abusing his mother, and he leaves before police arrive. Maya then leaves Tamaha.

cards.title: Post-credits
cards.body: The mid-credits scene in the finale shows Fisk on a plane watching news coverage of a New York mayoral race with no clear front-runner. It sets up Daredevil: Born Again.

cards.title: Why it matters for Doomsday
cards.body: Weak link. It matters mainly as the lead-in to Daredevil: Born Again, which picks up Fisk's rise in New York. It is a street-level story with no cosmic or multiverse content. Maya, Fisk and Daredevil are not on Marvel's Doomsday cast list.

title: Deadpool & Wolverine
oneLiner: The TVA recruits Deadpool and a Wolverine variant to save a dying timeline.

cards.title: The story
cards.body: Wade Wilson has quit being Deadpool and sells used cars when the TVA grabs him. Mr. Paradox explains that Wade's universe is dying because its anchor being, that world's Wolverine, Logan, has died. Wade refuses to accept it, steals a TVA device and searches the multiverse for another Wolverine to replace him. He comes back with a grumpy, bitter variant, and Paradox sends the pair to the Void, a wasteland at the end of time ruled by Cassandra Nova.

cards.title: Key moments
cards.body: Cassandra Nova, Charles Xavier's twin sister, rules the Void. In it, the pair meet Chris Evans as a Fox-era Johnny Storm, who is killed by Cassandra, and then join a group of cast-offs: Laura, Elektra, Blade and Gambit. They use Juggernaut's helmet to block Cassandra's powers, but she escapes, takes the Time Ripper and plans to destroy every timeline. Wade and Logan destroy it together, and Cassandra dies. TVA agent Hunter B-15 arrests Paradox and lets Logan stay in Wade's universe.

cards.title: Post-credits
cards.body: Over the credits, behind-the-scenes footage from the Fox X-Men and Fantastic Four films plays to a Green Day song. A post-credits scene returns Deadpool to TVA headquarters, where he plays footage of Johnny Storm swearing at Cassandra in the car on the way to her base.

cards.title: Why it matters for Doomsday
cards.body: Doomsday has an announced X-Men cast, including Professor X, Magneto, Cyclops, Beast, Nightcrawler, Mystique and Gambit. Neither Deadpool nor Wolverine has been announced. This film is the earliest MCU place that mutants, the TVA and the idea of a dying universe show up together, which is why it is useful background. Whether any of it feeds Doomsday has not been stated by Marvel.

title: Agatha All Along
oneLiner: Powerless after WandaVision, Agatha Harkness joins a coven on the Witches' Road.

cards.title: The story
cards.body: Three years after WandaVision, Agatha Harkness is still stuck in the fake town of Westview, powerless and acting as 'Agnes' under Wanda's spell. A teenager she calls 'Teen' breaks the spell and talks her onto the Witches' Road, a magical gauntlet that rewards any witch who survives its trials. Agatha builds a coven that includes Lilia and Jen, while Rio Vidal, a witch from her past, hunts her. Each trial is built around a different witchcraft tradition.

cards.title: Key moments
cards.body: Teen is revealed to be Billy Maximoff, the son of Wanda and Vision, whose soul ended up in the body of a teenager named William Kaplan after a car accident. Rio turns out to be Death. Lilia sacrifices herself in episode 7, and Agatha dies in the finale after giving herself up to Death to save Billy. She returns as a ghost, and Billy seals the Road. Billy and Agatha then set out to find his brother Tommy.

cards.title: Why it matters for Doomsday
cards.body: Moderate link at best. It carries Billy Maximoff and the thread of Wanda's missing sons forward. Neither Billy, Agatha nor Wanda is on Marvel's Doomsday cast list, and Wanda's involvement is only a rumor. The series has no credits scene, so nothing is teased. Watch WandaVision first.

title: What If...?, Season 3
oneLiner: The final season of the animated anthology wraps up the Watcher's story.

cards.title: The story
cards.body: The third and final season has eight episodes, released daily from December 22 to 29, 2024. Each is a stand-alone alternate universe, including the Hulk fighting the Mech Avengers, Agatha in Hollywood, Red Guardian against the Winter Soldier, Howard the Duck getting married, and a 1872 story with Shang-Chi and Kate Bishop.

cards.title: Key moments
cards.body: The season ends with the Watcher on trial before the other Watchers for his repeated interference. Captain Carter sacrifices herself to take the group to Strange Supreme's universe, where the Watchers' conflict is resolved. The Watcher then invites Kahhori, Byrdie and Storm to help him watch over the multiverse.

cards.title: Why it matters for Doomsday
cards.body: Weak link. It is an animated side series set in alternate universes, and nothing in it is tied to Doomsday by any announcement. It closes out the Watcher's storyline, but the main films do not depend on it. No credits scenes have been reported for the season.

title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
oneLiner: A teenage Peter Parker begins his Spider-Man journey with Norman Osborn mentoring him, in a separate universe.

cards.title: The story
cards.body: This animated series is set in a separate universe from the main MCU. Peter Parker is a high school student who gains his powers and starts learning to be a hero, with Norman Osborn, the head of Oscorp, acting as his mentor instead of Tony Stark. The tone is warm and youthful, with school, friends and early adventures before the bigger villains arrive.

cards.title: Key moments
cards.body: Season 1 has ten episodes, released in batches from January 29 to February 19, 2025. Peter's powers come from a time paradox set off by Doctor Strange's time-travel during a symbiote fight. Norman's evolution toward the Green Goblin is the main long-term hook, and Doc Ock is also in the mix. Peter's secret identity is exposed along the way, and the season ends on a dark turn at his internship. It is self-contained, so it works as a friendly starting point for newcomers.

cards.title: Why it matters for Doomsday
cards.body: Separate universe, so it is not tied to Doomsday by any announcement. Tom Holland's Spider-Man is not on the Doomsday cast list. Treat this one as optional, and only watch it if you want more Peter Parker in a lighter, younger tone.

title: Captain America: Brave New World
oneLiner: Sam Wilson, the new Captain America, uncovers a plot that threatens President Thaddeus Ross and global peace.

cards.title: The story
cards.body: Sam Wilson is Captain America, leading a small team with Joaquin Torres, the new Falcon. Thaddeus Ross, the old general who hunted Hulk, has been elected President of the United States. At a White House summit, Ross reveals adamantium, a rare metal, has been found on Celestial Island, the remains of the Celestial Tiamut in the Indian Ocean, and proposes a treaty to share it. During the summit, Isaiah Bradley, the super-soldier from The Falcon and the Winter Soldier, opens fire after being triggered, and Sam has to work out who is controlling him.

cards.title: Key moments
cards.body: The mastermind is Samuel Sterns, the scientist from The Incredible Hulk, who now has superhuman intelligence and a grudge against Ross, who imprisoned him. Sterns's mind-control tech pushes American pilots into attacking Japan's fleet at Celestial Island, and Sam and Torres stop it. When Sterns is exposed, Ross transforms into the Red Hulk and wrecks part of the White House. Sam talks him down by reminding him of his estranged daughter Betty. Ross resigns and is imprisoned, Isaiah is cleared, and Torres is invited to join the Avengers.

cards.title: Post-credits
cards.body: In the post-credits scene, Sterns, now a prisoner on the Raft, tells Sam that something bigger is coming and that Sam's heroes are not the only ones protecting existence. Sam leaves unconvinced. It is the first time anything in this stretch of the MCU warns, in person, of outside forces arriving.

cards.title: Why it matters for Doomsday
cards.body: Sam Wilson and Joaquin Torres are on Marvel's confirmed Doomsday cast list. Thaddeus Ross and Samuel Sterns are not, and no reliable report says they appear. The adamantium and Celestial Island are the film's main long-term setup, though how they pay off is unannounced. Watch this before Thunderbolts*, and The Falcon and the Winter Soldier first if you can.

title: Daredevil: Born Again, Season 1
oneLiner: Matt Murdock and Wilson Fisk clash again as Fisk wins the mayor's office in New York.

cards.title: The story
cards.body: In the premiere, Bullseye (Dex) kills Matt Murdock's friend Foggy Nelson, and Matt tries to kill him. A year later, Matt has retired as Daredevil and works at a law firm. Wilson Fisk, the Kingpin, has gone legitimate and wins the New York mayoral election. A string of killings and corrupt police wearing Punisher skulls pull Matt back in, and the two enemies fight a long war in the courts and on the streets. It is more adult than most Marvel shows, with violence and a dark mood.

cards.title: Key moments
cards.body: Fisk forms an Anti-Vigilante Task Force, originally aimed at a killer called Muse. The task force becomes a tool for Fisk. Matt and Frank Castle, the Punisher, clash and then cooperate, Karen Page returns, and Heather Glenn is drawn into the fight. Dex escapes prison and shoots at Fisk at his ball, and Matt takes the bullet. In the finale, Fisk cuts power to the city and declares martial law, and Matt starts recruiting allies to resist him.

cards.title: Post-credits
cards.body: In the mid-credits scene of the finale, Frank Castle tricks a prison guard and escapes custody.

cards.title: Why it matters for Doomsday
cards.body: Moderate link at best. Fisk as Mayor with a vigilante task force is a big change for New York, but nothing announced connects it to Doomsday. Daredevil, Fisk and the Punisher are not on Marvel's Doomsday cast list. It is a very good show for Daredevil fans, but skippable for the main plot.

watchNote: Watch Daredevil on Netflix first if you can.

title: Thunderbolts*
oneLiner: A team of misfit anti-heroes is trapped in a vault and forced to work together.

cards.title: The story
cards.body: CIA director Valentina Allegra de Fontaine sends Yelena Belova, John Walker, Ghost and Taskmaster to a secret facility, each told to kill the others. It is a setup: she plans to burn the place down with them inside, along with proof of her own misconduct. They escape, free a dazed man named Bob, and learn he is the Sentry. Bucky Barnes and Red Guardian join the scramble as the group fights Valentina and each other.

cards.title: Key moments
cards.body: Valentina plans to present Bob as a hero, but he turns on her. His dark side, the Void, swallows New York in shadow. Yelena leads the team into Bob's mind, where they help him face his pain, and the Void fades. Valentina then presents the team to the public as the New Avengers, and Yelena tells her they now hold the leverage over her.

cards.title: Post-credits
cards.body: There are two scenes. In the mid-credits scene, Red Guardian pushes a supermarket shopper toward a Wheaties box with the New Avengers on it, and she puts it back when he turns away. The post-credits scene jumps fourteen months ahead to the old Avengers Tower, now the Watchtower. Sam Wilson is suing the team over use of the Avengers name, and Red Guardian floats a rename to dodge the case. Then an unknown craft from another dimension appears, with a large 4 on its hull, the Fantastic Four's ship. A title card promises the New Avengers and Bob will return.

cards.title: Why it matters for Doomsday
cards.body: This is the most direct runway to Doomsday, set fourteen months before it. Yelena, Bucky, Red Guardian, John Walker, Ghost and Bob are all on Marvel's confirmed cast list, as is Sam Wilson. Valentina is not on any official list, so her return is unconfirmed. The post-credits scene sets up the Wilson trademark feud and the Fantastic Four's arrival. Watch it right before Doomsday, ideally after Captain America: Brave New World.

watchNote: Watch after Brave New World, right before Doomsday

title: Ironheart
oneLiner: Riri Williams builds her own armor and gets pulled into a magic-powered criminal crew in Chicago.

cards.title: The story
cards.body: Riri Williams is a young genius from Chicago who builds her own Iron Man-style suit and is pushed out of MIT. Back home she falls in with a crew led by Parker Robbins, the Hood, whose power comes from a magical cloak. Riri also builds an AI copy of her late best friend Natalie into her suit. The six-episode series mixes street-level crime, tech and dark magic, far from the Avengers.

cards.title: Key moments
cards.body: The crew's heists go bad, Riri hides her part in a death, and Parker eventually orders her killed. She rebuilds her suit with magic from Zelma Stanton, which wipes the Natalie AI. In the finale a flashback shows Parker making a deal with Mephisto, played by Sacha Baron Cohen, for the cloak. Riri beats Parker, then Mephisto offers her a deal. She accepts on the condition that her loved ones are left alone, and Natalie is restored to life.

cards.title: Post-credits
cards.body: There is one credits scene, in the finale. Parker, who has lost his powers, visits the Stantons' magic shop and asks Zelma for help getting bigger magic. She does not answer before the scene ends.

cards.title: Why it matters for Doomsday
cards.body: Weak link. Mephisto's first MCU appearance is a tease for the magic side of the franchise, and Riri may return later. Ironheart is not on the confirmed Doomsday cast list, and the series sets nothing up for the film in any confirmed way. Skip it if short on time.

title: Eyes of Wakanda
oneLiner: An animated anthology about Wakanda's secret agents, the Hatut Zaraze, retrieving stolen vibranium across history.

cards.title: The story
cards.body: Eyes of Wakanda is a four-episode animated series released all at once on August 1, 2025. It follows the Hatut Zaraze, Wakanda's covert agents, as they retrieve stolen vibranium artifacts across history. Episodes jump between eras: Minoan Crete in 1260 BC, the Trojan War, Ming-era China in 1400 AD and Ethiopia in 1896. The cast is new, led by Noni, a disgraced former Dora Milaje. Ayo from the films does not appear.

cards.title: Key moments
cards.body: Noni defeats the rogue agent Nkati and joins the Hatut Zaraze. B'Kai spends years undercover in Troy as a Greek warrior. Basha slips into K'un-Lun and meets an Iron Fist wielder. In the finale, a future Black Panther arrives from five hundred years ahead with a warning that Wakanda's isolation leaves it open to an alien Horde. The episode ends years later with Killmonger preparing to steal an axe from a London museum.

cards.title: Why it matters for Doomsday
cards.body: Side story. Because it spans eras, it is placed at its earliest setting, 1260 BC, which is also where the official Disney+ timeline starts the whole MCU. It does not set up Doomsday in any confirmed way. The closing Horde warning is the only forward-looking idea, and nothing says it pays off in the film. Skip it unless Wakandan lore is the draw.

title: Marvel Zombies
oneLiner: An animated horror story in which Marvel heroes in a zombie-infested world fight to survive.

cards.title: The story
cards.body: Marvel Zombies is a four-episode animated horror series released all at once on September 24, 2025. In a world overrun by a zombie plague, survivors including Kamala Khan, Kate Bishop, Riri Williams and the AI F.R.I.D.A.Y. head to a S.H.I.E.L.D. base in Ohio to activate a transmitter. It continues the zombie universe from What If...? and is darker and bloodier than most Marvel shows.

cards.title: Key moments
cards.body: Kate dies and Riri is bitten in the first episode. Yelena sacrifices herself while defending the survivors at Zemo's sanctuary. A flashback shows T'Challa dying to stop a zombified Thanos. At New Asgard, Wanda is revealed as the mastermind behind the infected food. Most heroes die in the finale, and Kamala wakes in a seemingly restored world that Riri reveals to be an illusion.

cards.title: Why it matters for Doomsday
cards.body: Side story. It takes place in a different universe and does not set up Doomsday in any confirmed way. Kate Bishop is confirmed for the film, but that is the live-action version and unrelated to this series. Skip it if short on time.

title: The Fantastic Four: First Steps
oneLiner: Marvel's First Family faces a planet-eater on a retro-futuristic Earth-828, with a baby on the way.

cards.title: The story
cards.body: The film takes place on Earth-828, a separate universe with a retro-futuristic 1960s look, four years after Reed, Sue, Johnny and Ben gained powers from cosmic rays. Reed and Sue are expecting a baby when the Silver Surfer arrives with a warning that Galactus, a planet-devourer, has chosen Earth. The team flies into space to bargain, and Galactus offers to spare Earth in return for their unborn child. They refuse, and the fight over the planet begins.

cards.title: Key moments
cards.body: Sue gives birth to Franklin on the trip home, and the baby turns out to be very powerful. Back on Earth, the public turns on the team for refusing Galactus. Reed plans to move the planet away with teleportation bridges. The Silver Surfer is revealed as Shalla-Bal, a scientist from Zenn-La who served Galactus to save her world, and she ends up helping the heroes. Sue dies using all her power against Galactus, and Franklin brings her back.

cards.title: Post-credits
cards.body: There are two credits scenes. In the mid-credits scene, set four years later, Sue steps away while reading to Franklin. When she returns, a figure in a green cloak sits with him, holding a metal mask, and Franklin reaches toward it. Doom's face is never shown, and Robert Downey Jr. is reported to play him uncredited. The post-credits scene is the opening of the Fantastic Four's in-universe cartoon, which has no bearing on the plot.

cards.title: Why it matters for Doomsday
cards.body: This is the direct set-up. Doom meets Franklin in the mid-credits scene, though why he is interested has not been explained. Pedro Pascal, Vanessa Kirby, Joseph Quinn and Ebon Moss-Bachrach are all on the confirmed Doomsday cast list. The Thunderbolts* post-credits scene shows their ship arriving in the main MCU. Franklin's own role in Doomsday is unconfirmed.

title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
oneLiner: Four years after the world forgot him, Peter Parker protects New York alone and meets a young telepath.

cards.title: The story
cards.body: Four years after Doctor Strange's spell erased Peter Parker from everyone's memory, Peter stays away from MJ and Ned and patrols New York alone as Spider-Man. His overwork triggers new powers, including organic webbing. He gets pulled into a hunt involving the Department of Damage Control, which is searching for something called V-Max, and a telepath who hops between people's minds. She turns out to be Jean Grey, played by Sadie Sink. Peter turns to Bruce Banner for help with his changing body.

cards.title: Key moments
cards.body: Jon Bernthal's Punisher clashes with Spider-Man, and Mac Gargan returns as Scorpion in a mechanized suit. The ninja group the Hand, led by Snow, is also in the mix. Jean's sister Sara was another telepath that the DODC kidnapped and killed. Jean possesses Banner, and the Hulk attacks DODC headquarters. At the climax, Jean's rage freezes everyone at the facility but Peter. Frank Castle shoots at Jean, Peter takes the hit, and Jean keeps him alive remotely.

cards.title: Post-credits
cards.body: There is no mid-credits scene. The single post-credits scene shows Ned's Spidey Tracker app. Spider-Man's pin starts in New York, then the map zooms out to North America and past Earth into deep space. A title card says Spider-Man will return, without naming a film. Fans debate who or what this points to, including a link to Doomsday or Secret Wars, but nothing is confirmed.

cards.title: Why it matters for Doomsday
cards.body: The link is real but mostly indirect. Yelena Belova, now using the Black Widow name, appears and is on the Doomsday cast list. Mark Ruffalo's Banner and Jean Grey are here, but neither is confirmed for Doomsday. Tom Holland's Peter is not on any official Doomsday list, so any appearance is speculation. The post-credits tease could point at Doomsday or Secret Wars, and nothing says which.

title: Wonder Man
oneLiner: A struggling actor with secret powers and a washed-up Mandarin impersonator chase a Hollywood role.

cards.title: The story
cards.body: Simon Williams is an actor whose career keeps stalling, partly because he secretly has ionic powers and superpowered people are barred from Hollywood under the Doorman Clause. He befriends Trevor Slattery, the actor who played the fake Mandarin in Iron Man 3, and they audition together for a remake of an in-universe Wonder Man movie. It is a small, character-driven show under the Marvel Spotlight label, and all eight episodes were released on January 27, 2026.

cards.title: Key moments
cards.body: The Department of Damage Control recruits Trevor as an informant, straining their friendship. A black-and-white flashback episode explains how the Doorman Clause came about. Both men get cast in the remake after a strong audition at the director's mansion. During filming, Simon learns of Trevor's deal and destroys the set in an explosion. Trevor takes the blame and is jailed, and Simon later breaks him out of the DODC prison. The two fly away together.

cards.title: Post-credits
cards.body: There is no mid-credits or post-credits scene in any episode, including the finale.

cards.title: Why it matters for Doomsday
cards.body: Mostly background. The show ties in through Trevor Slattery and the DODC, which also appears in Spider-Man: Brand New Day. Wonder Man is not on the confirmed Doomsday cast list, and the show sets nothing up for the film in any confirmed way. Some commentary guesses Simon could join the heroes later, but that is speculation.

title: Daredevil: Born Again, Season 2
oneLiner: Mayor Fisk's task force hunts vigilantes while Matt Murdock decides how far to go to bring him down.

cards.title: The story
cards.body: Wilson Fisk is mayor of New York and runs an Anti-Vigilante Task Force. Matt Murdock has been unmasked as Daredevil, and Fisk turns the city against him. The season ran eight episodes, from March 24 to May 5, 2026. Matt, Karen Page and their allies try to prove that Fisk is smuggling weapons through the Red Hook port, while a smear campaign targets the mayor.

cards.title: Key moments
cards.body: Fisk's wife Vanessa is hit by a glass shard and dies after surgery, which pushes him further into darkness. Matt fights Fisk and Fisk survives. Jessica Jones returns to help, and Matt is shot at the courthouse. Heather Glenn takes up the Muse mask. In the finale Matt publicly admits he is Daredevil to get Karen's case dismissed and persuades Fisk to accept exile from New York. Matt is arrested and ends the season in prison. Bullseye takes over Mr. Charles's work, and Luke Cage returns to Jessica Jones.

cards.title: Why it matters for Doomsday
cards.body: Weak link. The season is a street-level story with no Avengers in it. Frank Castle is absent because Jon Bernthal was committed to The Punisher: One Last Kill and Spider-Man: Brand New Day. Valentina Allegra de Fontaine is mentioned but does not appear. Daredevil and Fisk are not on the confirmed Doomsday cast list. Worth watching if you like Matt and Fisk, but safe to skip.

watchNote: Pair with The Punisher: One Last Kill

title: The Punisher: One Last Kill
oneLiner: Frank Castle tries to put down the skull and finds he cannot, with a bounty on his head.

cards.title: The story
cards.body: Frank Castle has killed the last of the Gnucci family he blames for his family's deaths and tries to move on. Hallucinations of people from his past haunt him. At his family's graves a vision of his daughter Lisa stops him from ending his own life. Crime boss Ma Gnucci, played by Judith Light, puts a bounty on him for killing her husband and three sons, and criminals attack his apartment building. The special premiered on Disney+ on May 12, 2026.

cards.title: Key moments
cards.body: Frank escapes a burning building and protects a shopkeeper named Dre, his wife and their young daughter Charli. Charli gives him a paper rose, which he leaves on Lisa's grave, and he decides he still has work to do. He returns to the streets in a new costume. Karen Page appears as a vision, and Curtis Hoyle also appears. It runs alongside Daredevil: Born Again season 2, which explains why Frank is absent from that show.

cards.title: Why it matters for Doomsday
cards.body: Weak link. It is mainly a bridge to Spider-Man: Brand New Day, where Bernthal's Castle fights Spider-Man and later shoots at Jean Grey. Nothing here involves Doom, the Avengers or the multiverse, and nothing is confirmed to carry into Doomsday. Skip it if you only care about the road to December.

title: X-Men '97, Season 2
oneLiner: The animated X-Men are scattered through time and race home to stop Apocalypse.

cards.title: The story
cards.body: This animated season picks up with the X-Men scattered through time, from Ancient Egypt to the far future. They have to get back to the 1990s to stop Apocalypse, who has traveled there too. Season 2 premiered July 1, 2026 with three episodes and ran weekly to a nine-episode finale on August 12. It is animated, with its own continuity, separate from the live-action cast.

cards.title: Key moments
cards.body: In Ancient Egypt, En Sabah Nur rises against Pharaoh Rama-Tut, who is revealed to be Kang the Conqueror. Magneto is killed saving others from Apocalypse's black hole. Gambit is later turned into one of Apocalypse's Horsemen. Nightcrawler offers his life so that Rogue and Gambit can survive. In the finale Cable shoots Gambit, which unleashes Apocalypse.

cards.title: Post-credits
cards.body: The fourth episode has a mid-credits scene in which Wolverine, back in the 1990s, receives a Weapon X file from Captain America and Black Widow. The finale's mid-credits scene shows Mystique shooting Valerie Cooper and taking her identity as Graydon Creed is elected president.

cards.title: Why it matters for Doomsday
cards.body: The link is thin. It brings Kang back as Rama-Tut after the live-action Kang plan was dropped. Live-action Xavier, Magneto, Cyclops, Gambit, Nightcrawler and Mystique are confirmed for Doomsday, but this is a separate animated continuity and nothing is confirmed to carry over. Treat it as mood-setting for the mutant side, not required viewing.

title: VisionQuest
oneLiner: A rebuilt Vision hides in Edinburgh, a bounty hunter arrives, and Ultron comes back.

cards.title: The story
cards.body: VisionQuest is a sequel to WandaVision from creator Terry Matalas. Vision lives quietly in Edinburgh, working in a pub and talking to the AI personas in his mindspace while keeping Ultron locked up. When a bounty is placed on him, the hunter Paladin comes for him, and he runs with Tommy Maximoff, a teenager who may be his reborn son. Paul Bettany plays Vision and James Spader plays Ultron. The eight episodes aired from October 13 to November 10, 2026.

cards.title: Key moments
cards.body: J.A.R.V.I.S. sacrifices himself to save Vision. The Butcherbird killer turns out to be Jocasta, and Ultron takes control of Vision's body for a time. Vision accepts Tommy as his son. The buyer behind the hunt, the Client, is revealed as Virgil Horton. In the finale Jocasta is destroyed and Ultron kills Virgil. Ultron then threatens London with a nanite swarm, and Vision talks him down inside a sitcom he builds in his mind. Ultron stops and slips away. Billy and Tommy help save their father.

cards.title: Post-credits
cards.body: The finale, Forever, has two end scenes. First, Ultron is shown keeping Jocasta's data drive. Second, a shadowed, hooded figure wakes Wanda Maximoff beneath Mount Wundagore, saying Scarlet Witch should awaken because her power will be his. The scene does not name him. Several outlets read him as Doctor Doom, which is unconfirmed. The scene replays Wanda's burial from Multiverse of Madness.

cards.title: Why it matters for Doomsday
cards.body: This is the most direct lead-in of the Phase 6 shows, but it stays ambiguous. Wanda is alive and someone wants her power, with a fan reading pointing at Doom. Olsen is not on the official Doomsday list, so her role is unconfirmed, as is Vision's. If you only watch one show before December, this is the one, ideally after WandaVision.

title: Avengers: Endgame Encore
oneLiner: Endgame returns to theaters with new scenes built to bridge the film into Doomsday.

cards.title: What it is
cards.body: On September 25, 2026, Endgame returned to theaters as Avengers Endgame: Encore, ahead of Doomsday, with new footage shot during Doomsday production. Runtime is about 185 minutes, though premium formats such as IMAX and Disney's Infinity Vision differ slightly. Scene order differs by print, and some theaters reportedly miss the TVA scene.

cards.title: What is new
cards.body: The ending is extended. As Steve and Peggy dance in their home, there is a knock. Peggy opens the door to Loki in his TVA outfit, who says he can help both of them, and Steve steps out to face him. The scene stops there without saying what Loki wants.

cards.title: Post-credits
cards.body: Further scenes play during and after the credits. In one, Bruce Banner records a video diary about his gamma research in an underground facility. A green glow appears, the camera cuts out, and an unseen voice, widely read as Doctor Doom, says he has come to collect him as the Hulk roars. In the TVA scene, Mobius and O.B. watch two Earths fire on each other, including the Fox X-Men universe, and then thousands of universes appear as O.B. says the multiverse is collapsing. The last scene shows Doom shaping his mask, with the hammering sound echoing Tony Stark's in Endgame. Sources differ on where this takes place.

cards.title: Why it matters for Doomsday
cards.body: It is the clearest on-screen bridge between Endgame and Doomsday. Steve, Peggy and Loki are confirmed for the film, and the trailers show Steve and Peggy with their teenage son. A TVA connection to what Loki wants is a fan guess. Banner appears only in this bonus scene, and his role in Doomsday is not confirmed. Worth seeing for the multiverse setup despite the short length of the new material.

title: Avengers: Doomsday
oneLiner: Doctor Doom takes on the Avengers, the Fantastic Four and the X-Men in the Russos' return to Marvel.

cards.title: What we know
cards.body: Directed by Anthony and Joe Russo and written by Stephen McFeely and Michael Waldron, Doomsday opens in the US on December 18, 2026. Robert Downey Jr. plays Doctor Doom. Marvel lists Chris Evans, Hayley Atwell, Chris Hemsworth, Tom Hiddleston, Anthony Mackie and Sebastian Stan, among many others. The Fantastic Four cast and the X-Men actors, including Patrick Stewart, Ian McKellen, Kelsey Grammer, James Marsden, Alan Cumming, Rebecca Romijn and Channing Tatum, are also confirmed. Stewart died in October 2026, and Marvel calls this his final on-screen appearance. The final trailer shows Steve and Peggy with their teenage son.

cards.title: The trailers
cards.body: Four teasers ran before Avatar: Fire and Ash in December 2025, the first revealing Chris Evans' return as Steve Rogers. A first full trailer debuted at CinemaCon in April 2026 and went online in July. A Doom-focused special look followed in August, and the final trailer arrived in November.

cards.title: Why Doom instead of Kang
cards.body: Marvel announced Kang Dynasty and Secret Wars at Comic-Con in July 2022, with Jonathan Majors as Kang. Marvel dropped Majors in December 2023. Director Destin Daniel Cretton stepped down in November 2023. By early 2024 the scripts were being rewritten to minimize Kang. At Comic-Con in July 2024 the Russos were announced as directors, the film was retitled Doomsday, and Downey was revealed as Doom. Kevin Feige has said Doom is not a Tony Stark variant.

cards.title: What to expect
cards.body: Only what Marvel or the Russos have said on record. Feige has said the film picks up where Endgame left off. Not confirmed: Wanda, Bruce Banner, Valentina, Franklin Richards, Namora, Attuma, Spider-Man, Doctor Strange, Wolverine and Deadpool. Reports of Ryan Reynolds and Hugh Jackman involvement, or a Sandra Huller cameo with unknown role, remain unconfirmed.

title: Avengers: Secret Wars
oneLiner: The Russos close out the Multiverse Saga one year after Doomsday.

cards.title: What we know
cards.body: Avengers: Secret Wars is set for December 17, 2027, directed by the Russo brothers from a script by Michael Waldron, Stephen McFeely, Chris McKenna and Erik Sommers. Robert Downey Jr. plays Doctor Doom in Doomsday and was announced in 2024 as the villain of both films. It closes out Phase Six and the Multiverse Saga. Spider-Man: Brand New Day's post-credits scene is sometimes read as pointing here, but that is unconfirmed.

title: The Fox X-Men films (2000-2019)
oneLiner: The original X-Men movies from another studio, whose stars are now in Doomsday.

cards.title: What they were
cards.body: Before Disney bought Fox in 2019, Fox made its own X-Men movies, starting with X-Men in 2000. They ran as a separate series from the MCU, with their own timeline and casting. Patrick Stewart played Professor X, Ian McKellen played Magneto, James Marsden played Cyclops, Rebecca Romijn played Mystique, Alan Cumming played Nightcrawler, and Kelsey Grammer played Beast. Channing Tatum was cast as Gambit for a solo film that never got made.

cards.title: Why it matters for Doomsday
cards.body: Stewart, McKellen, Grammer, Marsden, Cumming, Romijn and Tatum's Gambit are all on Marvel's confirmed Doomsday cast list. That is the main reason this node is on the timeline. Stewart died in October 2026, and Marvel calls Doomsday his final on-screen appearance. The film places the X-Men on Earth-10005, and how these versions reached the main MCU is not explained in anything official.

title: Netflix Daredevil & The Defenders (2015-2019)
oneLiner: The Netflix street-level Marvel shows whose Matt, Fisk and Frank carry into Born Again.

cards.title: What they were
cards.body: Between 2015 and 2019, Netflix made a run of Marvel shows set in New York: Daredevil, Jessica Jones, Luke Cage, Iron Fist, the team-up The Defenders, and The Punisher. They were grittier and more violent than the movies. Charlie Cox played Matt Murdock, Vincent D'Onofrio played Wilson Fisk, and Jon Bernthal played Frank Castle. After Netflix dropped them, Disney brought those characters into the MCU one by one.

cards.title: Why it matters for Doomsday
cards.body: Weak link. Matt, Fisk and Frank carry over into Daredevil: Born Again, The Punisher: One Last Kill and Spider-Man: Brand New Day, and Jessica Jones and Luke Cage return in Born Again season 2. None of them is confirmed for Doomsday, and none of it is confirmed to feed into the film. If you only care about the road to December, skip these shows.
